lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately four primary horizontal rows extending from the posterior gill margin. The spacing between centroids is relatively uniform in the mid-flank, increasing slightly towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, with the high-luminance blobs serving as the primary anchor nodes at these intersections, forming a visible rectangular grid across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper lateral flank. These features exhibit a sharp vertical gradient, with a high-luminance highlight on the upper edge and a low-luminance shadow immediately below, indicating structural ridges.

other_distinctive_markers: The ventral-lateral pectoral fin shows a high density of small-diameter high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the primary flank.
